technology_name: Power System Simulation and Training Platform-(FSS Mini)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Limited access to power system simulation tools for education and small-scale studies
description: FSS Mini is a miniature full-spectrum simulator capable of providing offline and real-time simulation of power systems. It is intended for educational applications and small-scale system simulation studies.
applications:
Engineering colleges, universities, and technical training institutes
Power system research and development laboratories
Electric utilities and power distribution companies
Industrial training centers and skill development organizations
Power system software, simulation, and testing solution providers
